questions.passage: Wilson and Linville’s experiment shows that having a role model— knowing someone who went through similar, tough experiences but ended up successful—can provide the idea and hope that it is possible to improve and survive. The key example of story editing here was how the students viewed their bad academic performance in the first semester. Instead of saying, “I am not smart enough to be at Duke,” they learned to say, “First year is tough for everyone; even smart kids struggle.”

Concluding that low grades can never be improved.

认定低分永远不能提高。
把录取杜克当作不应遇到困难的证据。
把大一困难看成常见挑战，而非自己能力不够的证明。
analyses: A 榜样提供改善的想法和希望，没有说代替做功课。
B possible to improve正相反。
C even smart kids struggle反对此种解读。
D 两种内心话的对比是关键：从“不够聪明”转为“聪明学生也会挣扎”。此处解释希望机制，不承诺每人必成功。

questions.translation: Wilson和Linville的实验表明，有一个榜样——知道有人经历过类似的艰难处境而最终成功——能带来一种想法和希望：提高表现并坚持下来是可能的。这里故事编辑的关键，在于学生如何看待自己第一学期糟糕的学业表现。他们不再说“我不够聪明，不配在杜克”，而学着说“大一对每个人都难；即使聪明的学生也会挣扎”。

evidence.quote: Wilson and Linville’s experiment shows that having a role model— knowing someone who went through similar, tough experiences but ended up successful—can provide the idea and hope that it is possible to improve and survive. The key example of story editing here was how the students viewed their bad academic performance in the first semester. Instead of saying, “I am not smart enough to be at Duke,” they learned to say, “First year is tough for everyone; even smart kids struggle.”

questions.prompt: Which outcome was reported for students who heard about struggles?

questions.promptZh: 听挣扎故事的学生报告了哪项结果？
